faq.question: Why should I choose a static website?
faq.answer: Static websites are pre-built pages that open instantly without waiting for a slow database. They are secure, rarely break, cost almost nothing to host, and load smoothly even on slow mobile internet.

faq.question: How long does it take to finish?
faq.answer: Most websites are ready in 4 to 7 days once you send us your logo, photos, and basic company details.

faq.question: How does payment work?
faq.answer: We accept local bank transfers (CBE, Telebirr, Awash, etc.). We start work with a small initial deposit, and you pay the rest after you review and approve the final website.
